name: Swift
description: Swift is the modern language for Apple platforms — iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS. It is fast, safe, and expressive, powering everything from the iPhone apps you love to server-side systems. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: The Swift Programming Language (Official)
items.description: The official Swift book by Apple covering the complete language from basics to advanced features like generics, protocols, and memory safety.

items.title: Hacking with Swift (Free Edition)
items.description: A massive free collection of Swift tutorials, projects, and challenges by Paul Hudson. Covers SwiftUI, UIKit, and Swift itself.

items.title: Swift Apprentice (Kodeco)
items.description: A free book for beginners learning Swift step-by-step with practical exercises and real-world examples.

items.title: swift.org
items.description: The home of the Swift project — compiler, standard library, package manager, and community resources.

items.title: Apple Developer Documentation
items.description: Apple's official Swift documentation with guides, API references, and Xcode integration resources.

items.title: Swift Package Index
items.description: A searchable catalog of open-source Swift packages with documentation, code coverage, and compatibility badges.

items.title: Stanford CS193p — SwiftUI Course
items.description: Stanford's famous iOS development course using SwiftUI. Available for free on YouTube with assignments and lecture slides.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — iOS & Swift Course
items.description: Comprehensive free Swift tutorials and iOS development courses ranging from basics to advanced SwiftUI.

items.title: Stanford CS193p — Developing Apps for iOS (YouTube)
items.description: Stanfords official iOS development course recorded live. The gold standard for learning Swift and SwiftUI.

items.title: Paul Hudson — Hacking with Swift Playlist
items.description: Over 1,000 free Swift tutorials on YouTubecovering Swift basics, SwiftUI, and practical iOS app development.

items.title: Exercism — Swift Track
items.description: 100+ free coding exercises designed to teach idiomatic Swift with automated analysis and optional mentoring.

items.title: Codewars — Swift Kata
items.description: Solve community-created challenges in Swift across hundreds of difficulty levels.

items.title: LeetCode — Swift Support
items.description: Practice algorithms and data structures using Swift for technical interview preparation.

items.title: Swift Cheatsheet (devhints)
items.description: A concise one-page reference covering Swift syntax, optionals, closures, and collection types.

items.title: Swift Evolution
items.description: Track the evolution of Swift through accepted proposals, from initial pitch to final implementation.

items.title: Swift Weekly Brief
items.description: A weekly newsletter summarizing Swift evolution updates, open-source contributions, and community discussions.

items.title: Swift.org Blog
items.description: Official Swift.org blog with release announcements, community highlights, and language evolution updates.

items.title: Reddit r/swift
items.description: The largest Swift community on Reddit for discussions, app showcases, and technical questions.

items.title: Swift Forums (Official)
items.description: The official Swift server for language design discussions, evolution proposals, and community support.

items.title: Swift Discord
items.description: Active real-time chat community for Swift developers with channels for iOS, server-side, and package development.
